山姆的生活方式(Sam's Way of Living): 一篇关于生活服务的B1记叙文:山姆的经历、感受与成长。

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The neighborhood station has become an important part of daily life. On Wednesday evenings, Sam reviews the notes from class. Smoke rose from the chimney.

Sam is saving money to buy a ticket to Paris. The post office looked quieter than usual that evening. Sam has practiced volleyball for three years and won a prize last term. Also, july is hot and humid here.

Little by little, things began to change. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. People around Sam often share different ideas about the post office. Farmers churn cream to make butter.

Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. At first, Sam found it difficult to keep the habit. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. In fact, wear your mac; the forecast says rain later.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. The experience taught Sam more than any book could. Sam plans to study math harder this term.
